artworks.title: Catherine II
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.2 x 12.9 cm (8 3/8 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of the upper part of a woman's body in profile, facing right. Only her head and shoulders are visible. Her face is turned to the side, showing her nose and facial features. She has styled hair with a crown and a laurel wreath, and a ornate garment with a lace-like neckline. The woman is identified as "Catherine II." There is no jewelry or objects visible. The portrait is framed in an oval with a patterned border. Her name is below the portrait in a decorative box. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Isaac Newton
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.2 x 14.9 cm (8 3/8 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man shown from the chest up, facing left in profile. He has classic features with a prominent nose and a well-defined jawline, wavy hair styled away from his face. He is dressed in a traditional draped garment and the background features an oval frame within a decorative rectangle, with the name "NEWTON" displayed below the portrait in capital letters.

artworks.title: Pierre Corneille
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man, in profile facing to the right. He has a prominent nose, receding hairline, and curly hair. The man is wearing a garment with a high collar, revealing a cravat or necktie. The portrait is enclosed within an oval medallion, set in a rectangular frame. Below the image is an engraved label that reads "P. CORNEILLE." The background provides a textured contrast to the oval and the figure. The engraving is set on a lightly speckled backdrop.

artworks.title: Thomas Corneille
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a portrait of Thomas Corneille. The portrait depicts the head and upper shoulders of the person in a side profile facing left. The man has long, wavy hair, a prominent nose, and a strong chin. He is dressed in a formal jacket with a visible lapel and neck cloth. The engraving is circular, surrounded by a decorative border, against a dark etched background. Below the portrait is a nameplate that reads "THO. CORNEILLE." The background is lightly speckled paper.

artworks.title: Antoinette du Ligier de La Garde Deshoulieres
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Elisabeth Sophie Cheron
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a woman named Mademoiselle Deshoulieres. She is depicted facing forward with a slight turn of her head. Her facial features include a gentle smile, high cheekbones, and a softly defined chin. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with curls and is adorned with a decorative headpiece. She is dressed in an elegant garment with a low neckline and draped shawl. There are no visible jewelry. The frame around the portrait has a lined pattern and an ornate plaque displaying her name. The background is simple and unadorned.

artworks.title: Jean de La Bruyere
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving showing a bust-length view of a person in profile, facing to the right. The individual is seated or depicted upright, with their head turned slightly in profile. They have curly hair that reaches their shoulders, and their facial features include a prominent nose and a defined chin. The person is dressed in formal attire, consisting of a coat with a high collar. The background of the portrait consists of an oval frame set against a textured rectangular field, with an inscription below the image that reads "J. DE LA BRUYERE." The entire setup is rendered in a monochromatic style characteristic of engravings. The space surrounding the portrait is blank and forms the outer border of the engraving.

artworks.title: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Jean-Antoine Houdon
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person's head and shoulders, facing right. The individual has distinct features, medium-length gray, wavy hair, and is wearing a draped garment. The background has a circular pattern, and below the portrait is a plaque with "J.J. Rousseau" inscribed.

artworks.title: Despreaux-Nicolas Boileau
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after François Girardon
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved bust portrait of a person in profile, facing left. The person has a prominent nose, a slightly pursed mouth, long, curly hair, and is shown from the chest upwards. The individual wears a garment with folds, and the oval frame within a rectangular border includes the inscription "BOILEAU" below the portrait. The background features a textured crosshatched surface within the borders against a plain outer backdrop.

artworks.title: Charles Louis de Secondat Montesquieu
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in profile, with defined facial features including a pronounced nose and chin, short curly hair, and a draped garment. The engraving is framed within an oval with the name "Montesquieu" inscribed below the image. The background is textured with horizontal lines while the rest of the page is plain.

artworks.title: Salomon Gessner
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Vivant Denon
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body in profile view. He is positioned in a way that highlights his side profile, with distinct features such as a prominent nose, receding hairline, and curly hair towards the back of his head. He is wearing a collared shirt with a scarf tied at the neck. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with fabric at the top. Below the frame is a scroll with French text. The background has textured diagonal lines, creating a contrast with the smooth lines of the man's profile. The overall style is elegant and classical, resembling engraved portraits.

artworks.title: Commentaire sur la Henriade
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Clément-Pierre Marillier
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.4 x 15.1 cm (8 7/16 x 5 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a title page of a book with three bust-like portraits in ornate frames. The central figure is in profile with styled hair, set in an oval frame with laurel leaves and ribbons and held by two cherubs. Flanking him are two other figures also in profile with styled hair. Below the portraits is a block of text with the title and publication information in French and Latin for "La Henriade" in Berlin, 1775. Below the text is an emblem with theatrical masks and foliage. The scene is surrounded by intricate lines and patterns accentuating the historical and scholarly theme of the title page.

artworks.title: Simon-Nicolas-Henri Linguet
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22 x 15 cm (8 11/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image contains a head-and-shoulders portrait of an individual facing slightly left, with the head turned towards the viewer. The person has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, a narrow nose, and slightly parted lips. The individual has short, curly hair styled away from the face, and is dressed in a garment with a fur-lined collar and richly-textured fabric. There is no visible jewelry or objects, and the portrait is set within an oval frame with a patterned border. Below the portrait, a nameplate reads "S. N. H. LINGUET" along with biographical information. The background is textured and neutral.

artworks.title: François Marie Arouet de Voltaire
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Jean-Baptiste Lemoyne II
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man, shown in profile facing left. He has a prominent nose, a slight chin, long wavy hair styled back, and is dressed in a high-collared shirt or cravat with a jacket or coat. The portrait is surrounded by a decorative oval frame with a laurel wreath at the bottom. In the background, there are intricate lines creating depth to the etching. Below the image, there is an inscription with the name "François Marie Arouet de Voltaire." The background outside the oval frame is plain.

artworks.title: Peter the Great
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a head and shoulders profile portrait of a man within an oval frame. The subject is positioned in a side view facing to the left. He has a prominent nose, curly shoulder-length hair styled in waves. The man wears a high-collared garment with intricate details and a brooch. A rectangular border surrounds the oval frame with the name "PIERRE Ier." The background is plain with a textured area around the frame.

artworks.title: Simon-Nicolas-Henri Linguet
artworks.medium: engraving over etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a central medallion portrait of a man with white, somewhat curly hair, a prominent aquiline nose, and a formal attire. Surrounding the portrait, there is a scene with an older, bearded winged figure holding a scythe above the medallion and small winged cherubs engaged with scrolls and sheets of paper below. The cherubs appear in dynamic poses, with one holding a scroll, another offering laurel branches, and a few huddling near an anvil. The background shows swirling clouds, and there is French text inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Garden Gate
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Natalie Fuller Allen and her children
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor scene with a partial structure. The perspective is set above and to the side, looking down at the scene. The horizon is not visible. The environment is portrayed using fine brushstrokes and cross-hatching, creating a textured look. The color palette is warm sepia tones. A figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat is sitting on the ground in a contemplative pose, partly hidden by shadows. A wooden gate is slightly open, leading into a leafy area that extends into the background filled with dense foliage.

artworks.title: The Virgin Swooning [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure in a dramatic pose with arms raised upwards and head tilted back. The figure appears to be kneeling or sitting on its heels, enveloped in flowing drapery that accentuates the figure's form. The sculpture is portrayed in a drawing with shades of gray and brown, likely done in pencil or charcoal. The material of the sculpture is not specified. The sculpture is shown in a way that places it above eye level, emphasizing the raised arms and upward gaze.

artworks.title: Two Drapery Studies [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two separate studies of drapery and fabric. The upper half shows a finely shaded area of fabric with parallel lines indicating texture. The lower half features a detailed drawing of a bent arm, covered in a loose-fitting sleeve. The fabric is softly shaded to show creases and folds, giving a sense of three-dimensionality and weight. The drawing includes faded script and a number "20" in the central area.

artworks.title: Tower of the Cathedral at Sens
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, brush and black ink, black chalk, and watercolor over graphite on brown paper
artworks.description: Two buildings nearly meet on either side of a more distant white cathedral tower in this loosely rendered watercolor drawing. The building to the right takes up two-thirds of the composition, and has a tall, pale brown roof, round-topped arches, and a section with gray engaged columns and pillars. The bottom zone is loosely sketched in with a few faint gray lines. Farthest from us, the white tower between the other two buildings has four levels of pointed arches. A spire extends from the right front corner of the tower, and the top edge of the entire structure is lined in spiky ornamentation. The third building, close to the left edge of the sheet, is a two-story wood structure with a tiled roof. The sky is painted ice blue in the narrow slivers between the buildings with some blank areas suggesting streaks of clouds. Cursive writing in graphite along the right edge of the paper reads, “Stairs and columns of Gothic arch Building.”

artworks.title: A Leaf from the Kelmscott Chaucer
artworks.medium: set in Chaucer and Troy types in black and red with decorative initials by William Morris, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of a beige textured book cover with a label and ties. The cover is light beige linen with two fabric ties on the right side. In the center, there is a rectangular label that reads "A Leaf from the KELMSCOTT CHAUCER. Together with a Monograph by Carl Purington Rollins." The text is black with selected phrases in red. The design highlights fine craftsmanship associated with book arts and the Kelmscott Press.

artworks.title: Trees by a Rail Fence
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. David Cleveland
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a large, gnarled tree, a winding path, houses in the distance, and a fence leading towards the tree. The sketch features detailed line work for texture and shading for depth, using a monochromatic color palette of gray and tan.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a standing male figure. The person has a slightly bent posture, implying movement. The facial features are faint, and the figure appears muscular. The hair is loosely rendered. The figure is nude and holds a staff in one hand with minimal detail. The background has light shading but no specific environmental details. The artwork seems to be an early or rough pencil or charcoal sketch.

artworks.title: Skaters on the Serpentine in Hyde Park
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with figures skating on a frozen river. Men in period attire are skating on the ice, with cottages and a leafless tree in the background. The sky is blue with white clouds, and the landscape extends into the distance. The painting features delicate brushwork with fine details and a color palette of blues, greens, and browns.

artworks.title: A Fête Galante with Falconers
artworks.medium: red chalk over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Neil and Ivan Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in elegant attire on a grassy area. One man gestures towards others while another operates a small theater. A small dog is nearby. In the background, there are rolling hills and sparse vegetation leading to a clear sky. The drawing is made using red chalk, giving it a soft, textured look with detailed strokes. The color palette is red and brown against a light tan background.
